SELECT mu.id AS userId, mu.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, mu.nickname AS nickname, ia.id AS id, ia.create_time AS applyTime, ia.approver_remark AS approverRemark FROM member_user mu INNER JOIN identity_apply ia ON ia.user_id = mu.id
AND ia.doc -> '$.inviteCode' = #{inviteCode} AND ia.doc -> '$.level' = 2 AND ia.source = 2 AND ia.status = #{applyStatus}
AND mu.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')
ORDER BY ia.id DESC
